content:
Webb County commissioners have voted to hire the accounting firm Weaver and Tidwell to conduct a forensic audit of the Webb County Sheriff's Office, at a cost of up to $396,000, according to KGNS.

A forensic audit is a deep examination of a department's financial records, KGNS reported. County officials said the price had been negotiated down somewhat from an earlier figure, though KGNS did not report the original amount.

The county auditor recommended the full audit over a cheaper alternative priced at about half as much, arguing that the lower-priced version would miss a significant amount, according to KGNS. Commissioners also found that the audit would serve the public interest.

KGNS did not report a vote count, a start date, or a timeline for completing the audit, and it did not detail the specific records the firm will examine beyond the department's finances.

Sources:

  • KGNS, “Webb County to pay up to $396K for sheriff’s office audit,” October 28, 2026

title: Webb County approves up to $396,000 forensic audit of Sheriff's Office
